1.explanation:
1. Data/README.md – gives the conventions for Data-related components and where a DataTableGroup would conceptually belong.  
2. DataTable/README.md – documents DataTable props (including groupBy) and how grouping is configured.  
3–4. DataTable stories – show live examples of DataTable usage (with and without theming/typescript), so you can see exactly how groupBy is toggled.  
5. Select/README.md – shows how the Select component API works (value, onChange, options), which is the building block for the “Group by…” dropdown.  
6. Select stories – demonstrates Select in context (themed), so you can match styling/behavior when wiring up the groupBy selector.
1.bug_scenario: The user is missing a dedicated DataTableGroup component to control the DataTable’s groupBy prop. In the screenshots they highlight the DataTable header area where a “Group by…” dropdown (implemented via the generic Select component) would live, with items like Date, Time, Type, Source, Partition, Severity, etc. They expect a built-in DataTableGroup control that renders a Select listing the DataTable’s groupable columns and wires its selection to the table’s groupBy value.
